en.title: CQRS Is Not Event Sourcing (and Doesn't Need Two Databases)
en.subtitle: CQRS splits one model into a command side and a query side. Separate stores, messaging and event sourcing are optional steps with their own costs.

ar-EG.title: الـ CQRS مش Event Sourcing ومش محتاج 2 databases
ar-EG.subtitle: الـ CQRS بيقسم الـ model الواحد لـ command side و query side. والـ stores المنفصلة والـ messaging والـ event sourcing خطوات اختيارية وليها تمنها.
